title: Étale origin of inverse finite coefficient realization
statement: For every bounded constructible finite-stage object K on a six-functor space X, the inverse of the canonical coefficient realization has bounded-below etale origin. The proof uses [lem-weil-pbc-finite-ring-constructible-derived-origin], bounded cohomology of K, and the coefficient equivalence; it imposes no Tor restriction.

source.place: Composition and coherence sentence, realized using the specified finite operation normalizations.

proof.text: The finite cohomological support of K gives explicit lower and upper bounds. Apply finiteRing_constructibleDerived_origin to its intrinsic constructibility and these bounds. Lift the resulting comparison through the canonical coefficient equivalence. The bounded constructible etale preimage is bounded below, which supplies the plusEtaleOrigin witness for inverse realization.

theorem finiteRealization_etaleOrigin (X : SixFunctorSpace D)
    (K : sixFunctorFiniteCategory D C E n hn X) :
    letI := Padic.finite_coefficientExtensionRing C.l E n hn
    DerivedCategory.plusEtaleOrigin
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing C.l E n)))
      X.obj.left ((realization (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) (hn := hn) X).inverse.obj K.obj)
